title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Salesforce TPM Analyst
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Technical Program Manager (Salesforce TPM)

A Technical Program Manager at Salesforce (or in a Salesforce-focused role) is responsible for the end-to-end execution of complex technical initiatives. They bridge the gap between high-level organizational strategy and technical engineering execution.


Core Responsibilities:

Program Delivery: Overseeing the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from initiation to completion using Agile and Lean methodologies.

Stakeholder Alignment: Leading Steering Committee meetings to make key decisions, remove obstacles, and align vision across cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Scrum Leads, UX).

Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identifying blockers, managing dependencies across multiple scrum teams, and developing mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement: Driving engineering excellence by refining release planning and program structures.


Required Skills:

Experience: Typically in enterprise software or technical program management.

Technical Depth: Deep understanding of SaaS/PaaS business models and the ability to master technical subjects relevant to the program.

Communication: Outstanding executive presence with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Trade Promotion Management (Salesforce TPM)

If the role is specifically for Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, TPM refers to a consultant or manager who optimizes how brands manage trade spend and promotions.

Getmereferred.com

Getmereferred.com


Core Responsibilities:

TPM Implementation: Designing and configuring components like promotion planning, fund management, and claims settlement.

Industry Expertise: Applying knowledge of the Consumer Goods (CPG) industry to drive ROI through AI-powered scenario modeling and budget optimization.

Integration: Ensuring TPM solutions integrate seamlessly with other modules like Sales Cloud or Marketing Cloud.

Required Skills:

Strong understanding of the TPM lifecycle: planning, budgeting, execution, and analytics.

Certifications in Salesforce (Admin, Platform App Builder) are often mandatory for these specialist roles.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: ANALISTA GOVERNANCA SR
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido - São José Dos Pinhais (PR)

Responsabilidades e atribuições

▶️Estruturar e sustentar os pilares de Governança, Capacidades e Desenvolvimento da IS/IT, atuando de forma transversal entre as áreas de Talent, Planning & Strategy e as áreas técnicas. O(A) Analista será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade das informações de pessoas e recursos, governança de processos e documentação, além de apoiar a evolução das capacidades da IS/IT por meio de planejamento de recursos, treinamento e padronização de práticas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Governança de Pessoas, Recursos e Acessos

Coordenar e executar o processo de Onboarding e Offboarding da IS/IT, assegurando a criação, atualização e suspensão de IPNs e a integridade das informações ao longo da jornada de acesso.

Gerenciar e manter atualizada a S

taff List da IS/IT (Brasil), garantindo confiabilidade, rastreabilidade e suporte às análises gerenciais.

Monitorar a regularidade documental e de compliance de terceiros, em interface com a área de Gestão de Terceiros, reduzindo riscos operacionais e apontamentos de auditoria.


  • Capacity Planning e Gestão de Capacidades

Conduzir o Capacity Planning da IS/IT, consolidando informações de recursos, capacidades, demandas e alocações.

Apoiar a liderança na tomada de decisão sobre balanceamento de capacidade, prioridades e evolução das equipes.

Garantir consistência e disponibilidade das informações de capacidade para análises recorrentes e fóruns de governança.


  • Treinamento, Digital Academy e Desenvolvimento

Coordenar as atividades do Digital Academy da IS/IT, incluindo organização de trilhas, acompanhamento de aderência e evolução de conteúdos.

Desenvolver, manter e acompanhar o Plano de Treinamento da IS/IT, garantindo alinhamento com competências, funções, gaps de capacidade e prioridades estratégicas.

Atuar em interface com Talent, liderança e áreas técnicas para garantir coerência entre necessidades do negócio e capacitação.

Gerenciar a ferramenta Hermine, assegurando qualidade de dados, governança das informações, parametrizações e suporte às áreas usuárias.


  • Governança de Processos, Métodos e Documentação

Apoiar a implementação e disseminação de metodologias e boas práticas (ITIL, COBIT, BPMN, PDCA, SWOT, entre outras).

Identificar oportunidades de padronização e melhoria de processos, propondo ajustes em fluxos, controles e documentação.

Apoiar as áreas da IS/IT no atendimento a evidências, controles e documentações exigidos para auditorias e certificações.

Conduzir ações de atualização, revisão e consolidação do inventário documental da IS/IT, garantindo versionamento, consistência e aderência aos padrões de governança



Requisitos e qualificações

  • Forte afinidade com Governança, Processos e Organização da Informação.
  • Capacidade de articulação com múltiplas áreas (IS/IT, Talent, Gestão de Terceiros, Operações e fornecedores).
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e estruturado, com atenção a detalhes e recorrência.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e transversais.
  • Formação superior em TI, Administração, Engenharia, Processos, Governança ou áreas correlatas. ✳️
  • Conhecimento prático de Governança de TI e Gestão de Processos (ex.: ITIL, COBIT, BPMN).
  • Conhecimento básico a intermediário de Segurança da Informação e Compliance, especialmente em contextos de auditoria.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, com foco em Excel e PowerPoint.
  • Inglês intermediário. ✳️
  • Espanhol intermediário. ✳️


Desejável:

  • Vivência com onboarding/offboarding, gestão de acessos ou staff list.
  • Experiência com capacity planning, gestão de recursos ou dados de pessoas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas corporativas (SharePoint, Forms, Planner).
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Copilot ou ferramentas de produtividade assistida por IA.
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes auditáveis ou regulados.


Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Global Campus Outreach Partner
description:
We are looking for dynamic and well-connected individuals within the university ecosystem to help expand our student contributor network for AI/LLM evaluation projects.


As a Country Campus Outreach Partner, you will play a key role in connecting with universities, student communities, and academic networks to onboard qualified students interested in flexible AI-related gig opportunities.


This is an ideal opportunity for individuals passionate about AI, education, and community building, while gaining exposure to the global AI ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations within your country.
  • Promote SME on demand/short term AI & LLM centric opportunities to university students.
  • Identify and engage student ambassadors and academic contacts to expand outreach.
  • Conduct virtual information sessions or campus awareness activities.
  • Support onboarding and orientation of new student contributors.
  • Track outreach progress and provide monthly updates on engagement and onboarding metrics.
  • Ensure a steady pipeline of qualified student participants for gig projects.


Success Metrics for the given role:


  • Number of universities engaged
  • Number of student contributors onboarded
  • Engagement sessions conducted
  • Active participation and task completion by onboarded students

title: Analista de Suporte TI – SCCM (MECM)
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


#LI-CR1

#LI-HYBRID


Local: Cidade de Deus – Híbrido (3x presencial / 2x remoto)

Horário: 07h às 16h, 08h às 17h ou 09h às 18h

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Administrar e manter o ambiente SCCM (System Center Configuration Manager) em infraestrutura corporativa.
  • Planejar e executar distribuições de software , patches , builds e atualizações de SO .
  • Garantir conformidade , aplicação de baselines e políticas de segurança nas estações de trabalho.
  • Realizar manutenção dos endpoints , troubleshooting, ajustes de inventário e correções preventivas.
  • Apoiar processos de homologação e Change Management , assegurando entregas seguras e controladas.
  • Desenvolver relatórios de compliance , indicadores e análises de evolução das distribuições.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos essenciais:

  • Experiência comprovada com SCCM / MECM em ambientes corporativos.
  • Conhecimento sólido em GPO (Group Policy Objects) .
  • Familiaridade com criptografia BitLocker , gestão de aplicativos e boas práticas de endpoint management.
  • Vivência com processos de homologação e gestão de mudanças (ITIL/Change Management) .

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft (MD-102, AZ-900, MS-102 ou correlatas).
  • Conhecimentos em Intune , PowerShell e automação de rotinas.
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos ou de grande escala.

Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

title: Global Campus Outreach Partner
description:
We are looking for dynamic and well-connected individuals within the university ecosystem to help expand our student contributor network for AI/LLM evaluation projects.


As a Country Campus Outreach Partner, you will play a key role in connecting with universities, student communities, and academic networks to onboard qualified students interested in flexible AI-related gig opportunities.


This is an ideal opportunity for individuals passionate about AI, education, and community building, while gaining exposure to the global AI ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations within your country.

Success Metrics for the given role:


  • Number of universities engaged
  • Number of student contributors onboarded
  • Engagement sessions conducted
  • Active participation and task completion by onboarded students

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Java Software Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar;
  • 4+ years of experience in Java development;
  • Experience with Spring frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security);
  • Experience with microservice architecture and cloud platforms;
  • Good English skills (minimum B2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal with our support.


Nice to have

  • Strong experience with Angular 2+.


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Global Campus Outreach Partner
description:
We are looking for dynamic and well-connected individuals within the university ecosystem to help expand our student contributor network for AI/LLM evaluation projects.


As a Country Campus Outreach Partner, you will play a key role in connecting with universities, student communities, and academic networks to onboard qualified students interested in flexible AI-related gig opportunities.


This is an ideal opportunity for individuals passionate about AI, education, and community building, while gaining exposure to the global AI ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations within your country.
  • Promote SME on demand/short term AI & LLM centric opportunities to university students.
  • Identify and engage student ambassadors and academic contacts to expand outreach.
  • Conduct virtual information sessions or campus awareness activities.
  • Support onboarding and orientation of new student contributors.
  • Track outreach progress and provide monthly updates on engagement and onboarding metrics.
  • Ensure a steady pipeline of qualified student participants for gig projects.


Success Metrics for the given role:


  • Number of universities engaged
  • Number of student contributors onboarded
  • Engagement sessions conducted
  • Active participation and task completion by onboarded students

description:

Garantir confiabilidade, escalabilidade e performance de sistemas críticos, atuando na ponte entre desenvolvimento e operações, aplicando princípios de engenharia de software para resolver desafios de infraestrutura e operação.

title: Trilingual Recruiter
description:
We are currently looking for a Junior Recruiter to join our team and support our staffing and outsourcing operations Hybrid in Bragança Paulista, SP or São Paulo, SP.


This role is ideal for someone who is starting or developing a career in recruitment and enjoys connecting with people, building relationships, and identifying talent. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and comfortable communicating with candidates throughout the hiring process.


Experience supporting recruitment for the Spain market is considered a strong plus , as we work with international clients and candidates.


Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future roles
  • Conduct initial candidate screenings and interviews via phone or video
  • Evaluate resumes and candidate profiles based on role requirements

title: P2P Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

• Global Scale: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets.

• Industry Leader: Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, supporting a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets.

• Our Team: Backed by thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally.

• Our Culture: We operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments.


About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented P2P Merchant Operations Manager to join our dynamic operations team. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.


Responsibilities:

1. Maintain relationships with merchants and users on the platform.

2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.

3. Review and approve merchant applications.

4. Conduct market research.

5. Assist with other related operational tasks.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.

2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.

3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Jr Partnerships Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!

  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales

Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes

  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

title: ESPECIALISTA FISCAL (LUCRO REAL) SÊNIOR
description:
LER COM ATENÇÃO ANTES DE APLICAR NA VAGA


﻿Vaga direcionada apenas a profissionais com experiência comprovada e aprofundada no regime fiscal do Lucro Real, atuando em ambientes de alta complexidade tributária.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

➥ Atuar de forma estratégica, técnica e especializada nas rotinas fiscais e tributárias de empresas enquadradas no regime do Lucro Real , com responsabilidade direta pela apuração, revisão crítica e validação dos tributos ;

➥ Garantir a conformidade fiscal e tributária no Lucro Real , assegurando a correta aplicação da legislação vigente, interpretações normativas e o cumprimento rigoroso de prazos e obrigações acessórias;

➥ Realizar cruzamentos e análises profundas entre dados fiscais, contábeis e trabalhistas , com foco na identificação de inconsistências, riscos fiscais, contingências e oportunidades de correção específicas do Lucro Real ;

➥ Atuar como referência técnica do time fiscal em temas de Lucro Real , apoiando analistas juniores e plenos na resolução de apurações complexas, ajustes, exclusões, adições e interpretações fiscais;

➥ Liderar e estruturar processos fiscais voltados ao Lucro Real , incluindo rotinas de apuração mensal, trimestral ou anual, controles de base de cálculo, conferências e padrões de qualidade;

➥ Apoiar o relacionamento técnico com clientes de maior maturidade , participando de reuniões, análises de cenários tributários, esclarecimentos técnicos e alinhamentos estratégicos;

➥ Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da área fiscal com foco em Lucro Real , apoiando definições técnicas, padronizações, posicionamentos tributários e boas práticas;

➥ Atuar de forma preventiva e crítica , antecipando riscos fiscais, autuações, contingências e impactos tributários relevantes decorrentes da apuração pelo Lucro Real;

➥ Apoiar discussões técnicas relacionadas a planejamento tributário, compliance, governança fiscal e estruturação de controles específicos do Lucro Real , quando aplicável.


HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS NECESSÁRIOS

➥ Ensino Superior Completo em Ciências Contábeis (CRC ativo ou apto a registro);

➥ Experiência sólida, comprovada e contínua em Lucro Real , atuando com alta complexidade tributária e elevado grau de autonomia técnica;

➥ Domínio aprofundado da legislação tributária aplicável ao Lucro Real , normas fiscais, instruções normativas e obrigações acessórias;

➥ Vivência prática e aprofundada nos regimes fiscais:

  • Lucro Real (requisito essencial e eliminatório)
  • Lucro Presumido (serviços)
  • Simples Nacional

➥ Forte capacidade analítica, senso crítico e visão sistêmica dos impactos fiscais, contábeis e financeiros do Lucro Real no resultado e na estratégia do negócio ;

➥ Experiência com controles fiscais específicos do Lucro Real , tais como:

  • Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL
  • PIS e COFINS (cumulativo e não cumulativo)
  • Exclusões, adições e compensações
  • Controles e conciliações fiscais e contábeis

➥ Afinidade com tecnologias aplicadas às rotinas fiscais complexas, automações e ambientes digitais ;

➥ Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir temas tributários complexos em orientações claras, objetivas e seguras ;

➥ Habilidade de relacionamento profissional e postura consultiva junto a clientes e áreas internas;

➥ Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas Google Workspace;


LOCAL

➥ Porto Alegre/RS


CARGA HORÁRIA

➥ 40 horas semanais

➥ Das 8h às 12h e das 13h30 às 18h


MODALIDADE

➥ Regime de contratação CLT

➥ Modelo de atuação presencial


O QUE A COMECE OFERECE

➥ Ambiente inovador, com forte estímulo ao crescimento técnico e profissional, aprendizado contínuo e troca entre especialistas;

➥ Atuação em projetos relevantes para empresas de tecnologia em tração e maturidade , com alta complexidade tributária;

➥ Vale refeição/alimentação;

➥ Vale transporte ou ajuda de custo para deslocamento;

➥ Seguro de Vida;

➥ Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (coparticipação);

➥ Espaço para experimentação, testes e evolução profissional;

➥ Free coffee ☕;

➥ Ambiente colaborativo;


DADOS DE APOIO AO CANDIDATO


ORIENTAÇÕES PARA ENVIO DO CURRÍCULO (REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIO)


O currículo deverá evidenciar de forma clara, objetiva e comprovável a experiência prática do candidato em rotinas fiscais complexas, com atuação direta no regime de Lucro Real, incluindo apuração, revisão crítica e validação de tributos.


Serão considerados apenas currículos que atendam aos seguintes critérios:


1. DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA DA EXPERIÊNCIA TÉCNICA


O candidato deve apresentar, para cada experiência profissional relevante:


Nome da empresa

Período de atuação

Cargo ocupado

Descrição objetiva das atividades executadas, com foco em:

Apuração de tributos no Lucro Real

Rotinas fiscais nos regimes Lucro Real, Presumido e/ou Simples Nacional

Participação ativa em fechamentos fiscais mensais

Revisões críticas, validações e análises de apuração tributária

Atuação em ajustes fiscais (adições, exclusões, compensações)

Conciliações fiscais e contábeis

Interação com clientes ou áreas internas em temas fiscais relevantes


⚠️ Não serão considerados currículos com descrições genéricas, superficiais ou sem evidência de atuação prática.


2. COMPROVAÇÃO DE ATUAÇÃO PRÁTICA


O currículo deve deixar evidente:


Nível de autonomia na execução das apurações fiscais

Participação direta em fechamentos fiscais completos

Complexidade das empresas atendidas (porte, faturamento, volume de operações, regime tributário)

Envolvimento em análises críticas, revisões técnicas ou identificação de riscos fiscais

3. REFERÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS (OBRIGATÓRIO)


O candidato deverá informar, no mínimo, 3 referências profissionais diretas, vinculadas à sua atuação técnica.


Cada referência deve conter obrigatoriamente:


Nome da empresa

Nome completo do contato

Cargo do contato

Relação profissional com o candidato (ex: gestor direto, sócio, cliente, líder técnico, etc.)

E-mail corporativo

Telefone para contato


⚠️ As referências poderão ser contatadas durante o processo seletivo para validação técnica, nível de autonomia e qualidade das entregas realizadas.


4. DIFERENCIAL RELEVANTE


Será considerado diferencial:


Experiência com empresas no Lucro Real em ambientes de maior complexidade operacional

Atuação em revisão e estruturação de processos fiscais

Experiência com análise de riscos fiscais e contingências

Participação em discussões de planejamento tributário

Experiência com cruzamentos de dados fiscais, contábeis e financeiros

Vivência com ferramentas tecnológicas, automações ou BI aplicados ao contexto fiscal
