title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Kafka, Kubernetes)
description:
DomainTools is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Team. This role is perfect for a creative problem-solver with deep expertise in large-scale data engineering and a passion for technical leadership and continuous improvement. You'll be a key technical collaborator, not only designing and maintaining complex systems but also accelerating engineering productivity and mentoring the next generation of engineers.

We are looking for someone with a strong background in Python, Rust, GoLang, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes) who is eager to take on big challenges and deliver high-quality, impactful results.


Job Responsibilities

  • Design, code and maintain web-scale data systems
  • Discover, analyze and validate new data sets to add value for our customers
  • Creative problem solving to necessarily complex systems
  • Research, prove and employ cutting edge techniques & technologies
  • Provide code reviews, design feedback, demos, technical requirements & documentation
  • Provide accurate, scope, estimates for time, capacity & costs of projects
  • Improve the lives of your coworkers by accelerating engineering productivity, reducing operational toil and increasing consistency
  • Provide technical leadership, assist in on-boarding & mentoring of junior engineers


Key Applicant Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional development experience with Python, GoLang, Rust or equivalent languages. Expertise in Rust and Python is highly valued.
  • 3+ years of experience with cloud infrastructure, specifically AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • 3+ years of experience with web-scale data engineering, leveraging data stores such as OpenSearch, Postgres (or PSQL), CockroachDB and Spark.
  • 3+ years of professional experience with Kafka.
  • 5+ years of experience working with Linux/Unix environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to coordinate effectively between multiple teams.
  • A positive attitude, strong interpersonal skills, and a genuine enjoyment of collaborating with, mentoring and assisting teammates.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Demonstrated history of high initiative and productivity that consistently adds value.
  • A proactive attitude towards continuous learning, particularly in unfamiliar domains.
  • Excited and passionate about working within the security space.


Pluses

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science/related field or equivalent experience
  • Design, implementation and/or maintenance of CICD & microservices
  • Experience with Data Pipelines such as ElasticSearch, NATS or Apache Airflow
  • Experience with data mining or machine learning techniques
  • Experience with text codec, encoding & web protocols
  • Bash, Scala, C, or Hive development experience
  • Experience with full stack development


More Details:

  • 100% remote in Brazil
  • Salary: up to $90,000 per annum

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

description:

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

Aqui, a Engenharia é tratada como cidadã de primeira classe: você terá voz ativa, participará das decisões estratégicas junto a Produto e Design e terá autonomia para propor e construir soluções.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura


Desejável

  • Experiência com soluções financeiras ou fintech (pagamentos, billing, recorrência, webhooks)
  • Sólida base em System Design e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e)
  • Vivência em ambientes de startup de alto crescimento
  • Familiaridade com cultura DevOps


Modelo de Contratação

PJ


Oferecemos

  • Cartão flexível ajuda de custo R$265,00
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados)
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Rotina remota de trabalho
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Analista de Negócios  - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista de Negócios - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

– Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

– Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

– Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

– Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

– Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

– Auxílio creche;

– Seguro de vida;

– Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

– Parceria com instituições de ensino;

– Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

– Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

– Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

– Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

– Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

– GetVibes – nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuação em uma empresa global da área da saúde.
  • Atuação 100% home office, em horário comercial.
  • Contratação CLT.


O que esperamos de você:


• Experiência com atuação junto à área de negócios

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

• Apoio na documentação e manutenção de processos, com acompanhamento de KPIs e geração de insights

• Business cases e Business plans

• Conhecimento avançado em Excel e ferramentas como Jira ou Azure

• Inglês intermediário/avançado



Diferenciais:

  • Experiencia com saúde
  • Certificação Agil



O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js- Backend)
description:
About Us

HG Insights is the global leader in technology intelligence, delivering actionable AI driven insights through advanced data science and scalable big data solutions. Our platform informs go-to-market decisions, and we influence how businesses spend millions of marketing and sales budgets.

What You’ll Do

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work as part of our Product Engineering teams
  • Architect, design, and implement service-oriented backend systems and APIs
  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs
  • Collaborate on ideas across the team, from concept through production
  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment

title: Especialista de Suprimentos
description:
Especialista de Suprimentos | Equipamentos e Materiais Estratégicos de Geração, Transmissão e Distribuição de Energia


Resumo da posição

Liderar a estratégia de sourcing para equipamentos críticos do negócio de energia, atuando em um ambiente de alta complexidade, restrição de oferta e dinâmica global.

O profissional será responsável por garantir competitividade e segurança de fornecimento, por meio de decisões estruturadas de categoria, desenvolvimento de fornecedores internacionais e gestão de riscos na cadeia de suprimentos.


Principais responsabilidades

- Liderar Strategic Sourcing end-to-end para equipamentos e materiais críticos, em contratações de alta complexidade e valor.

- Estruturar e implementar estratégias de categoria, considerando concentração de mercado, risco de fornecimento, capacidade global, dual sourcing e planejamento plurianual.

- Conduzir sourcing global, incluindo prospecção, desenvolvimento e homologação de fornecedores internacionais (avaliação técnica, auditorias, compliance, capacidade fabril e risco geopolítico/logístico).

- Desenvolver análises robustas de TCO, should cost, cost breakdown e total landed cost, incluindo variáveis como câmbio, logística internacional, tributos e riscos de supply chain, bem com análise de fórmulas paramétricas.

- Atuar de forma coordenada com COMEX, áreas tributária e regulatória, para definir estratégias de Incoterms, formação de preço importado, lead time, planejamento logístico, governança documental, bem como identificar e capturar oportunidades via regimes especiais e incentivos fiscais (ex.: Ex-Tarifário, REIDI).

- Monitorar e mitigar riscos de fornecimento, atuando de forma proativa com as áreas de negócio e Logística em expediting, inspeções (FAT/SAT), gestão de não conformidades e planos de contingência.

- Gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos globais, conduzindo negociações de alto impacto e promovendo parcerias de longo prazo.

- Atuar como interface estratégica com Engenharia, Construção e Manutenção, Logística, Jurídico e áreas corporativas, garantindo alinhamento técnico-comercial nas decisões.

- Negociação e pacificação de minutas contratuais complexas, envolvendo garantias, limites de responsabilidade, critérios para penalidades, etc.


Requisitos obrigatórios

- Formação superior em Engenharia (preferencialmente Elétrica ou Mecânica) ou áreas correlatas.

- Experiência sólida em Suprimentos estratégicos de equipamentos técnicos críticos, com alto valor agregado, longo lead time e elevada complexidade de mercado.

- Vivência comprovada em sourcing global e desenvolvimento de fornecedores internacionais.

- Forte experiência em gestão de categoria e Strategic Sourcing, em ambientes de restrição de oferta e alta dependência de fornecedores.

- Domínio de TCO, should cost, cost breakdown e total landed cost.

- Experiência prática com importação/Comex, incluindo formação de preço, Incoterms e gestão de lead time internacional.

- Vivência em gestão de risco de supply chain, incluindo contingência e mitigação de rupturas.

- Experiência com negociações complexas e contratos de alto valor.

- Excel avançado e experiência com ERP/SRM (SAP, Coupa ou similares).


Requisitos desejáveis

- Pós-graduação ou MBA em Supply Chain, Engenharia, Negócios Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.

- Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em ambiente global

- Experiência no setor de energia (geração, transmissão,distribuição) ou indústrias com cadeia global complexa.

- Vivência com regimes especiais (Ex-Tarifário, REIDI).

- Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI para gestão de indicadores e inteligência de categoria.


Competências comportamentais

- Visão sistêmica e orientação a valor, equilibrando custo, risco, prazo e confiabilidade do fornecimento.

- Forte capacidade de atuação em ambientes com restrição de oferta e alta pressão por prazo.

- Perfil consultivo e influente, com habilidade para navegar entre áreas técnicas e executivas.

- Pensamento analítico e tomada de decisão estruturada, mesmo sob incerteza.

- Habilidade avançada de negociação e gestão de stakeholders críticos.

- Senso de dono, pragmatismo e capacidade de destravar gargalos complexos.

- Resiliência e adaptabilidade em contexto de mercado aquecido e volátil.

title: Assistente de crédito
description:
Praia Brava/SC (Presencial)


A Basso é um Fundo de Investimento em Direitos Creditórios (FIDC), com sede em Passo Fundo/RS e escritório também na Praia dos Amores, em Balneário Camboriú/SC. Atuamos com foco em análise e gestão de crédito, sempre prezando por segurança, eficiência e excelência nas operações.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Crédito  para integrar nosso time em Balneário Camboriú/SC. Procuramos um perfil analítico, organizado e proativo, que tenha interesse em desenvolver conhecimentos na área de crédito e análise de empresas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar nas rotinas de análise de crédito de empresas;
  • Realizar conferência de documentos financeiros e cadastrais;
  • Consultar e interpretar relatórios de bureaus de crédito (ex: Serasa);
  • Auxiliar na organização e validação de informações para tomada de decisão;
  • Dar suporte às atividades operacionais da área.

Requisitos:

  • Perfil analítico e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Organização e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender;
  • Conhecimento básico em análise financeira será um diferencial;
  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento (preferencialmente em áreas como Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou afins).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com análise de crédito ou rotinas financeiras;
  • Familiaridade com relatórios de bureaus de crédito.


Se você busca crescimento em um ambiente dinâmico e com aprendizado constante no mercado financeiro, essa pode ser uma ótima oportunidade.

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

What You’ll Do

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work as part of our Product Engineering teams
  • Architect, design, and implement service-oriented backend systems and APIs
  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs
  • Collaborate on ideas across the team, from concept through production
  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade SaaS applications with large datasets
  • Experience designing or building AI-powered features or systems
  • Experience working with Python
  • Enjoys startup culture where individual contributions are visible, impactful, and valued

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.
